prompt: Add @remcostoeten/auth-drawer to my Next.js app. I use Better Auth — my client is created in `lib/auth-client.ts` and exported as `authClient` (it has signIn.email, signIn.social, signUp.email, useSession, and github+google social providers configured). Wire up the provider, the drawer, and a navbar that shows sign-in when logged out and the user + sign-out when logged in.

assertions.text: Wraps the app in the real AuthProvider (from the package) with the adapter, and renders <AuthDrawer>
Session/header uses useAuth() (the real hook) rather than a hand-rolled provider/hook
Handles CSS correctly: relies on the package's out-of-the-box styles and does NOT present a manual styles.css import as required
No nonexistent/invented imports or props (no createAdapterError import, no invented hooks/flags)
createBetterAuthAdapter receives { client: authClient }; 'use client' on client components
